task_summary: Draft three Bridge 2 manuscript variants, then publish four bridge-validation skills

steps.title: Restore state, verify TeX toolchain
steps.description: Reload from artifacts (workspace was cleaned): bridge2_validation_packet.md, bridge2_model_facts.json, bridge2_synthetic.npz, false_friend_controls.csv, phase0_validated_bridges.csv, combined_text.csv and concept_embeddings.npy. Check for pdflatex/tectonic in the sandbox and record which PDF route is available, so the format decision is settled before drafting.

steps.title: Build verified bibliography
steps.description: Assemble the reference list by fetching real metadata (title, authors, year, venue, DOI) from OpenAlex/Crossref for every work cited — Ding 2019, Taherian Fard & Ragan 2017, plus the Waddington/Huang/Hopfield lineage the two papers themselves cite. No reference goes in unless its metadata was retrieved. Deliverable: bridge2_references.bib and a bibliography check table.

steps.title: Render paper figure set
steps.description: Produce publication-grade figures with figure-style: Figure 1 — the shared six-role formal template with both models mapped onto it side by side; Figure 2 — the synthetic double-well validation (ground truth / GP surface / Hopfield energy) re-rendered at paper spec; Figure 3 — the false-friend negative controls as a role-mismatch panel. Save each as an artifact.

steps.title: Draft shared manuscript core
steps.description: Write the content shared by all three variants: abstract, the two extracted model definitions with real equations (ELBO, GP surface, Lyapunov energy E=-½PWPᵀ, Hopfield update), the shared formal template, the three-level equivalence adjudication, the synthetic-test results, failure modes, and the unification target. Saved as bridge2_core.md for reuse across variants.

steps.title: Variant A — narrow translation paper
steps.description: Assemble the narrow, hardest-to-dismiss version: Bridge 2 only, controls as a short validation subsection, engine mentioned once in Discussion. Emit LaTeX with real equation environments and compile to PDF. Deliverables: bridge2_paperA_translation.tex + .pdf.

steps.title: Variant B — translation plus method
steps.description: Extend Variant A with a full Methods section on the three-space bridge-discovery measure (primitive / concept / citation distance) that surfaced the pair, with the false-friend controls reframed as validation of the detector. Deliverables: bridge2_paperB_method.tex + .pdf.

steps.title: Variant C — position paper
steps.description: Reframe Bridge 2 as the worked example inside the broader argument that disconnected literatures share a computational grammar, incorporating the corpus-level statistics (0.71 computation / 0.26 language / 0.0002 citation). Deliverables: bridge2_paperC_position.tex + .pdf.

steps.title: HTML reading versions and comparison brief
steps.description: Build a self-contained single-file HTML reading version of each variant with base64-embedded figures (matching the existing review-panel pattern), plus variant_comparison.md laying the three side by side on framing, claim strength, referee risk, and what each sets up next — so the choice is a quick read rather than three full passes.

steps.title: Author the four validation skills
steps.description: Load the customize skill for the host.skills.* SDK, then author bridge-extract (fetch full text → six-role model card), bridge-align (two cards → template table), bridge-synthesize (the double-well falsification harness that adjudicates Level 3), and bridge-controls (concept-high/primitive-low false friends from a corpus). Each ships SKILL.md plus a kernel.py of reusable helpers.

steps.title: Publish skills and smoke-test
steps.description: Publish all four skills, then verify each loads cleanly and its kernel helpers are callable — running bridge-synthesize end-to-end on the stored double-well case to confirm it reproduces the Level-3 verdict. Report the one-call invocation for the next bridge.

desired_outputs: Three LaTeX manuscript variants (narrow translation / translation+method / position) with compiled PDFs
A side-by-side comparison brief to choose between the variants
Verified bibliography (real DOIs, no fabricated references)
Four published skills: bridge-extract, bridge-align, bridge-synthesize, bridge-controls

feasibility.rationale: The manuscript itself is well-supported — both papers' equations are already extracted from full text and the three-level verdict is backed by a running synthetic test. The honest limitation is that the paper's empirical core is currently a toy double-well demonstration rather than a real paired dataset, so I will mark the real-data experiment as the stated next step rather than claiming it; I will also verify a TeX toolchain exists and fall back to a different PDF route if not.
